headline: Russian security firms compete for control of Burkina Faso gold mine
summary: Russian private security companies are vying for control of protection services at a Burkina Faso gold mine operated by a company linked to billionaire Alexey Mordashov. The site is currently subject to $1 billion sale negotiations with another Russian miner.
why: Control over critical infrastructure and mining assets in resource-rich regions is a key geopolitical and economic interest for international mining conglomerates.
